m28_pooled_sanity_diagnostic.reason: Each m=28 pure-in-house subset has one test record, so per-subset R2_conv, Spearman rho, and Pearson r are undefined. The 26 valid unique held-out predictions are pooled only for the requested LOOCV sanity check.

metadata.R2_conv_definition: sklearn r2_score within each test set using that test set's actual mean as baseline
metadata.analysis: Sample-size-matched literature-data-value comparison predicting Xiao in-house records
metadata.model: StandardScaler fit on training rows only + Ridge(alpha=1.0)
metadata.within_2x_definition: abs(predicted log10 J - actual log10 J) <= log10(2)

pure_m28_pooled_vs_grouped_loocv.comparability_note: The pooled m=28 diagnostic covers 26 non-center records. The grouped LOOCV reference covers all 29 records and holds BBD4/BBD5/BBD6 out together.
